59 Years of Service
Founded in 1966, Ridgeville Elevator has supported farms and families across Northwest Ohio and beyond for nearly six decades.
4 Locations & 20+ Counties Served
With branches in Ridgeville Corners and Fayette, we proudly serve customers across Ohio, Michigan and Indiana.
6 Core Services, One Trusted PartneR
From grain marketing and agronomy to feed and show supplies, Ridgeville Elevator is your one-stop agricultural partner.
10,000 Acres Supported Annually
Our agronomy & field services reach tens of thousands of acres - helping local farmers succeed year in and year out.

THE RIDGEVILLE STORY
1966
Ridgeville Elevator is Founded
The Beck Brothers open the elevator to serve local farmers in Ridgeville Corners, Ohio.
1978
Incorporated Under Darwin Beck
Darwin Beck becomes sole owner and officially forms Ridgeville Elevator, Inc.
1986
Expansion into Agronomy Services
The company acquires Zehr and Co. fertilizer plants in Gerald and Ridgeville, launching the Gerald Ag Center and Ridge Fertilizer.
1999
Elery Branch Opens
Ridgeville Elevator acquires Clady Elevator in Malinta, Ohio, now known as the Elery branch.
2001
Fayette Branch Launches
The purchase of a Pettisville Grain location adds the Fayette branch to the Ridgeville family.
2019
A Legacy to Remember
Darwin Beck passes, but his commitment to integrity, progress, and community continues to guide Ridgeville Elevator.
